author: Traditional English nursery rhymes; collection illustrated by Blanche Fisher Wright
title: The Real Mother Goose
edition: Project Gutenberg 10607 transcription of The Real Mother Goose, illustrated by Blanche Fisher Wright, title page dated 1916; traditional English rhymes, no translator. Line endings and leading indentation normalized; stanza and line boundaries, spelling and punctuation retained. Illustrations excluded. The library text holds every rhyme in printed order under its printed title; the title page, the list of rhymes and the alphabetical list of first lines are omitted.

rights.basis: This original English text was published in 1916, before 1931, and its US publication copyright term has expired by 2026. Only the historical poem text is reproduced; modern editorial material and illustrations are excluded.

acquisition.method: Project Gutenberg plain text (pg10607.txt from the aleph.pglaf.org mirror) with the PG header, footer and licence removed; the title page, “A LIST OF THE RHYMES” and “AN ALPHABETICAL LIST OF FIRST LINES” omitted. From the half-title “THE REAL MOTHER GOOSE” (a level-1 heading) on, each capitalised one-line rhyme title became a level-2 heading and every other blank-line separated group a stanza, line breaks kept and leading indentation removed. Every Kindergarten night from this book was located block for block.
